pages.text: Growing tired of Servants losing their way to you, and/or using Call and Troop Focuses from afar, you've desperately wished you could just put your servants into your pocket so that you can unleash them wherever you wish.

After countless days of research and experimentation, you've created an odd box that fulfills your desire. By left-clicking one of your servants with it, it will instantly contain them. Holding down right-click will slowly pull out your servants from it, but will use up durability that will render it unusable until repaired, which can be done on an Anvil with Ender Pearls. It can hold multiple servants, and is immune to being burned in fire and lava. If destroyed while in thrown form, it will release every servant within itself.

There are some conditions when it comes to storing certain types of servants. Some servants take up more than one space within the tesseract, depending on their size, (and whether they're tagged properly). Limited life servants will have their lifespan paused when stored within the tesseract.
